reward_screen.description: The card reward screen after room 1 (3 seeded offers). Run mode.

removal_screen.description: The rest-room removal grid (the full deck, so removal is allowed). Run mode; seed 1 has its rest room at room 6.

boss_smash.description: The boss winding up its smash (cone) and landing it: shots 0.3 s and 0.6 s after the wind-up starts. Run mode, boss room.

bd1_reward_keystone.description: BD1: a Rogue reward screen offering Fan the Flames and Drive-By (Keystones) and Kindling (Primer).

bd1_reward_keystone_wizard.description: BD1: a Wizard reward screen offering Heat Sink and Parting Gift (Keystones) and Well, Actually (Payoff).

bd1_glow_target.description: BD1: a lit condition. Fan the Flames in the Attack: AoE slot with Burning enemies in its area (arena scenario, fixed deck).

bd1_primed.description: BD1: a primed slot and a lit one. Momentum cast at 0.3 s primes Attack: Single and lights Drive-By (arena scenario, fixed deck).

pl3_heavy_bolt.description: Overqualified Bolt cast by the Wizard (fixed deck, so the slot really holds it).

bd2_relic_elite.description: BD2: the relic offer after an elite room (3 relics and Skip; the elite replaces its card offer). Run mode, seed 1 has its elite at room 4; a fixed offer.

bd2_relic_room.description: BD2: the relic room (no fight; the offer opens at once). Run mode, seed 1 has its relic room at room 9; the player already holds Spite Knuckles.

bd2_relic_swap.description: BD2: the give-one-up step at a relic cap of 2. The player holds Pyre Insurance and Heavy Sigh and picks Lingering Embers in the relic room (seed 1, room 9); the second screen lists the two relics that can be given up and Cancel.

map_start.description: MAP1-B: the map at run start. The map screen with the room-1 nodes pickable and the legend, with the branching map forced on (--map; data/map.json now ships it on, so the flag is explicit rather than needed). Run mode, seed 1.

map_mid.description: MAP1-B: mid-run. Seed 54 along the first route, room 7 cleared (gold paid), its card offer rejected, so the map screen is open to pick the next node with 6 nodes already walked (a medium chest relic stage sits at room 6).

map_room9.description: MAP1-B: room 9. Seed 54, room 9 (an elite) cleared and its relic offer skipped; the only way on is the boss.

map_chest_large.description: MAP1-B: a large chest relic stage (seed 157, room 5, first route). No fight, the offer opens at once. A large chest draws from the act 3 row (tier 1 5, tier 2 25, tier 3 70 as shipped, min_tier 1).

map_chest_medium.description: MAP1-B: a medium chest relic stage (seed 54, room 6, first route).

merchant_shop.description: MAP2 (qa): the merchant's shop. Seed 54, map node 33 (the room 9 merchant), 200 gold, starter deck (the removal entry is greyed with its reason). Re-check the node id with tools\run_map_print.ps1 -Seed 54 if the generator changes.

merchant_shop_poor.description: MAP2 (qa): the same shop with 20 gold, so every item shows its 'Need N more gold' reason.

merchant_removal.description: MAP2 (qa): the merchant's card removal list with a full deck and 200 gold (the opening option id is merchant_remove_menu).

mini_boss_act1.description: MB1: the act 1 mini-boss (room 10 of a three-act run): the brute, Head of Facilities, alone (its chasers come from its phases). Run mode, seed 1.

act_transition.description: MAP3 ux: the act transition screen. The act 1 mini-boss (room 10) is cleared at 1 s, the relic and the card offers are skipped, and the Act 2 screen opens over the new map. Run mode, seed 1.

mini_boss_act2.description: MB1: the act 2 mini-boss (room 20 of a three-act run): the Corporate Raider alone, act 2 scaling and tint. Run mode, seed 1.

mini_boss_blink.description: MB1: the Raider's Golden parachute (blink): shots at 0.1 s (landing marker just drawn), 0.45 s (marker filling), 0.9 s (it has landed and the backstab winds up). Needs a renderer.

mini_boss_dash_combo.description: MB1: the Raider's Leveraged dash combo: shots 0.3 s into the first wind-up, and 0.3 s into the second link's wind-up (about 1.4 s in).

map_mini_boss.description: MAP3 ux: act 1's map with the mini-boss as the only way on (seed 1, room 9 (an elite) cleared and its relic offer skipped). Three acts: the HUD shows Act 1 of 3 and Room 9 of 30 behind the screen.

map_act2.description: MAP3 ux: act 2's map after room 14 (seed 1): the column numbers read 11 to 20, the title says Act 2 of 3, the hover says Room 15 and the line says every route ends at the mini-boss. Run mode.

final_boss_act3.description: MAP3-B: the final boss (room 30 of a three-act run), with act 3's enemy scaling. Run mode, seed 1.

bd2_pyre_explosion.description: BD2: a Pyre Insurance explosion. Arena scenario, fixed deck: a Burning enemy dies at 0.6 s and its Burn bursts over the three beside it.
